fixture: Passive clock ticks are paused. Three fair arrivals provide the starting wallet and trust. The harness places the player at the Inn or Task board on Saturday day 3, using 10:00 for the daytime cases and 20:00 for e08. Only e06 seeds a four-coin wallet.
method: Real native Godot viewport. Viewport clicks exercise arrival, feeding, the scholar's first page and the reputation panel.
